proposition: Shāhrukh summoned Ibn Turka to Herat to be tried again; on this trip he wrote the Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I and the creedal tract R. Iʿtiqādāt, both dated 829/1426 and addressed to Shāhrukh, and again earned Shāhrukh's favour and returned to Fars.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I (829/1426), addressed to Shāhrukh
mediation.note: written to the ruler who was judging him
the outcome ('again earned favour') is MK's summary
